source: 社评：全球好感度提升，中国做对了什么
expert: What has China done right to attract rising global favorability?: Global Times editorial

source: 美国时政新闻网站Axios援引美国晨间咨询公司一项涵盖41国的民意调查称，在近一年多的时间里，中国的全球好感度是一条稳步上升的曲线，尤其在今年3月以后呈现加速上扬态势。截至5月底，中国的全球净好感度为8.8，而美国的这一数据为-1.5。这是自该机构进行相关追踪以来，中国的全球好感度首次超越美国。这并非孤例，近年来多项国际调查都指向同一个趋势——世界看待中国的目光，正变得愈发友好与积极。
expert: The US political news outlet Axios, citing a poll conducted by the American firm Morning Consult covering 41 countries, reported that China's global favorability has been on a steady upward trajectory over the past year, with a notable acceleration since March of this year. As of the end of May, China had an 8.8 net favorability rating, compared to -1.5 for the US. This marks the first time since the tracking began that China's global favorability has surpassed that of the US in this metric. This is not an isolated case - numerous international surveys in recent years have pointed to the same trend: The world is viewing China with increasing warmth and positivity.

source: 全球好感度提升，在于中国始终是世界和平的建设者、全球发展的贡献者、国际秩序的维护者，这些努力和成就在国际社会中产生了积极影响。中国的发展进步不仅造福了本国人民，也为世界和平与发展作出了重要贡献。中国对世界经济增长的贡献率保持在30%左右，经济增长率在主要经济体中位居世界前列。共建“一带一路”走过十余载，已成为无数普通人生活中看得见、摸得着的改变。在非洲，中国企业参与建设的水电站点亮了万家灯火；在东南亚，一座座由中国技术和投资支撑的工业园拔地而起。这些项目不附加政治条件，不搞“教师爷”说教，只是真诚地回应伙伴国发展经济、改善民生的迫切渴望。世界感受到的，是中国“大家一起发展才是真发展”的包容和善意。
expert: The increase in global favorability is due to China's role as a builder of world peace, a contributor to global development, and a defender of the international order. These efforts and achievements have had a positive impact on the international community. China's development and progress have not only benefited its own people but have also made significant contributions to world peace and development. China's contribution to global economic growth remains around 30 percent, with its economic growth rate ranking among the highest of major economies in the world. The Belt and Road Initiative, now over a decade old, has become a source of tangible, visible change in the daily lives of countless ordinary people. In Africa, hydropower stations built with the involvement of Chinese companies have brought light to numerous households. In Southeast Asia, industrial parks supported by Chinese technology and investment are rapidly rising from the ground. These projects come with no political strings attached, no lectures or condescension - just a sincere response to partner countries' urgent aspirations for economic development and improved livelihoods. What the world is witnessing is China's inclusiveness and goodwill that true development means developing together.

source: 从斡旋沙特伊朗和解，到积极落实《巴黎协定》，从推动《区域全面经济伙伴关系协定》（RCEP）落地，到推动金砖合作机制扩员，中国向世界展现了一个负责任大国的形象。这背后，有先进理念的引领、务实行动的支撑。全球发展倡议、全球安全倡议、全球文明倡议自提出以来，得到100多个国家和国际地区组织的积极响应和支持，为变乱交织的世界注入宝贵的稳定性和正能量。积极贡献全球发展援助项目、推动热点问题政治解决、为加强文明对话注入新动力，中国准确把握时代发展大势，聚焦全人类共同福祉，反映各国人民求和平、谋发展的共同心声，赢得越来越广泛的全球认同。
expert: From facilitating the reconciliation between Saudi Arabia and Iran to actively implementing the Paris Agreement, from promoting the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership to expanding the BRICS cooperation mechanism, China has demonstrated the image of a responsible major power to the world. Behind this lies the guidance of advanced concepts and the support of practical actions. Since their inception, the Global Development Initiative, Global Security Initiative, and Global Civilization Initiative have received positive responses and support from over 100 countries and international organizations, injecting valuable stability and positive energy into a turbulent world. By actively contributing to global development assistance projects, promoting political solutions to hotspot issues, and injecting new vitality into civilizational dialogue, China has accurately grasped the trends of the times, focused on the common well-being of humanity, and reflected the shared aspirations of people around the world for peace and development, thereby gaining increasingly broad global recognition.

source: 对中国好感度的上升，也体现了世界对一个自信自立、坚持正义、扶弱扬善大国的认可和敬意。面对不断抬头的单边主义和保护主义，中国坚定站在历史正确的一边，推动建设开放型世界经济。面对霸权主义和强权政治，中国始终坚守正义、主持公道，坚定维护以国际法为基础的国际秩序，推动国际秩序朝着更加公正合理的方向发展。同时，一个国家的良好形象，还体现为软实力的不断提升。如今，中国的文化创造力正以前所未有的活力拥抱世界。从《原神》《黑神话：悟空》到TikTok、“小红书”，从微短剧热播海外、DeepSeek旋风到“China Travel”、“甲亢哥”，这些现象和产品的“破茧”效应，打破了西方媒体长期编织的信息茧房，让世界看到了一个科技感十足、历史底蕴深厚、人民热情开朗的真实中国。
expert: The rise in China's global favorability also reflects growing international recognition and respect for a confident, self-reliant major power that stands for justice, supports the weak and promotes goodwill. In the face of rising unilateralism and protectionism, China remains firmly on the right side of history, advocating for the development of an open world economy. Confronted with hegemonism and power politics, China consistently upholds justice, acts with fairness, and staunchly defends an international order based on international law - working to make that order more just and equitable. At the same time, a country's positive global image is also reflected in the continuous growth of its soft power. Today, China's cultural creativity is embracing the world with unprecedented vitality. From Genshin Impact and Black Myth: Wukong to TikTok and Xiaohongshu (RedNote), and from the popularity of micro-dramas overseas to the DeepSeek phenomenon, as well as "China Travel" and influencers like IShowSpeed, these phenomena and products that exhibit "breaking out of the cocoon" effects have shattered the information bubble that Western media has long created, allowing the world to see a real China that is rich in technological innovation, steeped in historical depth, and characterized by warm and open-hearted people.

source: 世界的好感，也来自中国开放包容的胸襟与面向未来的信心。中国深知，开放带来进步，封闭必然落后。我们持续扩大免签“朋友圈”，不断缩短外资准入负面清单，优化营商环境，让全球企业共享中国发展所带来的红利。汇丰最新发布的调查显示，在覆盖全球13个市场的5700多家跨国企业中，选择中国作为目标市场的比例为全球最高。中国在高端制造、绿色能源和人工智能等领域的创新突破，不仅驱动自身高质量发展，更以领先技术和优质服务，为解决人类共同挑战贡献“中国方案”。
expert: The world's favorability toward China ultimately stems from the country's open-mindedness and confidence in the future. China understands well that openness brings progress, while isolation leads to stagnation. We continue to expand our "visa-free circle of friends," shorten the negative list for foreign investment, and optimize the business environment to allow global enterprises to share in the dividends of China's development. According to a recent HSBC survey of over 5,700 transnational companies across 13 global markets, China is the most favored target market for increased business reliance. China's innovative breakthroughs in high-end manufacturing, green energy, and artificial intelligence not only drive its own high-quality development but also contribute "Chinese solutions" to addressing common challenges faced by humanity through advanced technologies and quality services.

source: 中国全球好感度的攀升绝非偶然。它是中国几十年如一日埋头苦干、和平发展的水到渠成；是坚持共商共建共享、践行真正多边主义的必然回响；是千千万万中国企业、文化工作者、普通民众用真诚合作、创新产品和友善笑容共同绘就的时代画卷。这份好感，是对中国道路的认可，是对中国贡献的肯定，更是人类命运共同体理念深入人心、落地生根的生动注脚。它提醒我们，大国形象的塑造，不在咄咄逼人的话语，而在润物细无声的实践；不在刻意营造的“人设”，而在持之以恒“做对的事”。沿着这条合作共赢、开放包容的道路坚定前行，一个可信、可爱、可敬的中国形象，必将在世界人民心中更加清晰、更加温暖。
expert: China's rising global favorability is no coincidence. It is the natural result of decades of dedicated hard work and peaceful development; the inevitable response to China's steadfast commitment to extensive consultation, joint contribution, and shared benefits under true multilateralism; and the collective portrait of an era, painted by countless Chinese enterprises, cultural workers, and ordinary citizens through sincere cooperation, innovative products, and warm smiles. It reflects recognition of China's path, affirmation of its contributions, and serves as a vivid testament to the growing resonance and grounding of the concept of a community with a shared future for mankind. It reminds us that the shaping of a major country's image lies not in aggressive rhetoric, but in quiet and consistent practice; not in a carefully crafted persona, but in the persistent pursuit of doing the right thing. By continuing on this path of win-win cooperation and inclusive openness, the image of a credible, appealing and respectable China will become ever clearer and warmer in the hearts of people around the world.
